subject: tests/browser/auth-role-failure-acceptance.mjs and docs/stabilization/reports/auth-failure-native-ready.json

supported: The runner signs in through the real web login and extension UI in a fresh owned Chrome profile.

It arms CDP Fetch on the side-panel target, reloads the panel, and requires at least one failed GET /rest/v1/admins request before accepting visible auth failure and a false worker-readable admin gate.
It removes the interception in finally, uses trusted pointer input on the product Try again control, and requires the same email, admin role, controls, and worker gate to recover.
It does not directly write auth state, role state, or the gate, and its result excludes credentials, URLs, request bodies, storage values, and raw exceptions.
unverified: No native run or result receipt exists for this runner; D29 failure-path acceptance cannot be marked pass from source review.
Safari failure/cancellation, simultaneous storage set/remove outage, cross-context write races, actual member transition, and server revocation remain outside this Chrome role-read scenario.

findings.finding: The match checks configured origin, GET, /rest/v1/admins, select=user_id, and presence of user_id, but does not verify the admin schema request header or that the user_id predicate equals the account authenticated in this run. A different request with the same route/query shape could satisfy injected_role_requests. Bind the predicate to the verified account ID and require the request's Accept-Profile: admin header before recording a failed role read.

The UI oracle uses any role=alert and any Try again button on the panel. Scope both to the AuthGate alert or check the role-read failure message, so an unrelated alert cannot satisfy the failure oracle.

The receipt and tree hash bind an exact unpacked artifact before and after execution, not a source commit. The earlier 0.2.92 artifact was built from c9abb17e; current 356c07d5 also includes a version bump to 0.2.93, plus the writeAuthRoleGate name and internal removal registry entry, with no role-write runtime change in that diff. A fresh validated 0.2.93 receipt is required for the planned run; report artifact and source identities separately.

positive_checks: The product query is adminDb().from('admins').select('user_id').eq('user_id', userId).limit(1), so the intended URL path and select predicate correspond to the real role lookup.
The AuthGate product renders a visible error and Try again button, and useAuth.retry revalidates the saved account; the runner does not inject their outcome.
The owned harness validates the child profile, CDP endpoint, extension ID, side-panel target, and worker target, and stops its own child on exit.

exact_allowlist_recommendation.execution: Run once through scripts/stabilization-resource.mjs run with AUTH_FAILURE_DEV_BUILD_RECEIPT set to the validated current local development receipt; preserve the resulting sanitized private receipt and wrapper admission record. Do not classify a resource refusal or setup failure as product failure.
